recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-15739; any future cleanup of the literal phrase 'referenced .focus' would be editorial polish outside the seed's semantic reconciliation.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 Task clarification asking to replace text saying operational detail is carried as the subject of the task with wording that it is carried in the referenced focus of the task.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit 2ebd7c6f7fc99b6938d5a223685af7907288d11c, which mentioned GF#15739, changed source/task/task-introduction.xml from the subject wording to referenced `focus` wording. Later Task introduction edits moved and reformatted the paragraph.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/task/task-introduction.xml is current build-scoped source. Later final Task issues FHIR-46344 and FHIR-15561 reintroduced or reinforced Task.focus guidance rather than reversing FHIR-15739. The current StructureDefinition defines Task.focus as what the task is acting on, and community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source no longer says operational detail belongs in Task subject and instead conveys that the detail is in the referenced focus of the task, supported by the current Task.focus definition and nearby Task.focus guidance.
